category.description: One of the 17 labels in categories.json, or 'not_a_311_issue'

agency.description: primary_agency for category; empty string if not_a_311_issue

description.description: In the user's language, 1-3 sentences, what and where

next_steps.description: In the user's language: what the user does / what the city does next

emergency.description: Immediate danger (downed wire, gas, fire, injury): app shows 'Call 911' and no filing flow

claude_model.description: Model id that served the response (response.model)
